_comment: New World wave 2 — the named works wave 1 (PR #4672) reported as absent from
the Internet Archive, planned for Biblioteca Digital Hispanica (BDH).
WHAT HAPPENED TO THE BDH PLAN (2026-09-07). BDH now redirects to the new
BNE Digital platform (bnedigital.bne.es), which sits behind a Cloudflare
human-verification challenge; curl, Node fetch and Hetzner all get the
'SE HA BLOQUEADO EL ACCESO' page, and a real Chrome gets the interactive
challenge. HathiTrust's page server (babel.hathitrust.org) is the same:
'Error - Blocked from HathiTrust' + a Cloudflare challenge, from both the
laptop and Hetzner. Neither is something a script may pass, so no BDH or
HathiTrust resolver was written — an importer that cannot be run is not a
deliverable. Gottingen's GDZ (for the 1906 Pietschmann Sarmiento) timed out.
THE REAL FINDING: wave 1's 'absent from IA' list was mostly a SEARCH failure.
IA catalogues Torquemada as 'monarchia yndiana' (1615) / 'monarchia indiana'
(1723), not 'monarquia'; the missionary grammars, Chimalpahin, Molina, the
Las Casas volumes and the Apologetica are all there under exact author
queries. This list is therefore an IA list, run with the wave-1 importer
(scripts/import/new-world-wave.mjs) unchanged except for optional
languages[]/language_multi passthrough for the bilingual editions.
SELECTION RULES (same as wave 1, plus what this wave learned):
- Earliest edition wins. Torquemada is the 1615 Seville FIRST edition (John
Carter Brown copy), not the 1723 Madrid reprint that is also on IA.
- Nothing printed after 1928. This excluded the 2008 Mendieta upload.
- Nothing that is not a SCAN. 'betanzos-juan-de.-suma-y-narracion-de-los-
incas-1880' has a jp2 zip and an 1880 date but its pages are a modern
typeset e-text with hyperlinked page numbers — looked at, excluded. Two
other Betanzos items are the same. The two Brazilian user uploads
(historia-do-brasil, cartaaaapdrmnelnobrg) were looked at and ARE scans.
- Volume numbers read from the scan, not the identifier. IA's
historiaindias0[1-4]casarich are Tomos I, II, IV, V — the '03' item is
TOMO IV (title page + running heads), which is why wave 1's 'Vol. 3'
label on it was wrong and was corrected in this wave. Tomo III comes from
the UNC set (historiadelasind15casa_1), verified the same way.
- Held already (work-level pass, hidden included): Munoz Camargo's Historia
de Tlaxcala (wave 1), Duran's Historia de las Indias de Nueva Espana, and
Tezozomoc's Cronica mexicana 1878 — which is the edition 'precedida del
Codice Ramirez', so want-list item 11 is already on the shelf inside
cronicamexicana00alvaiala. Not re-imported.
STILL MISSING after this wave (no scan on IA; BDH/HathiTrust human-gated):
Betanzos 1880 (Jimenez de la Espada); Mendieta 1870 (Icazbalceta;
HathiTrust ucm.5323538185 is full-view but unfetchable); Sarmiento's
SPANISH text (Pietschmann 1906 — only Markham's 1907 English is open);
Molina's SPANISH text (1913/1916 — only Markham's 1873 English is open);
Chimalpahin's Diario; Anchieta's 1595 Arte (1874 Platzmann facsimile
taken instead) and his Cartas (1933 ed. is post-1928). A residential
browser session that passes the BNE/HathiTrust challenge could fetch the
first three by hand; that is a person's job, not a script's.
LANGUAGE FIELDS follow .claude/docs/invariants/language-fields.md. Markham's
Sarmiento and Molina are English translation editions of Spanish works;
Barba's 1541 Democrates is a Spanish translation of Sepulveda's Latin; the
1560 Quechua grammar and lexicon are Spanish-language books about Quechua
(language Spanish, original_language Quechua, as wave 1 filed Montoya).

books.title: Primera parte de los veinte y un libros rituales y monarquía indiana
books.author: Juan de Torquemada
books.note: FIRST edition, Seville 1615, John Carter Brown copy. Volume number from IA volume metadata. The Franciscan Torquemada (c.1557-1624), not the 15th-century cardinal already in the catalogue.

books.title: Segunda parte de los veinte y un libros rituales y monarquía indiana
books.author: Juan de Torquemada

books.title: Tercera parte de los veinte y un libros rituales y monarquía indiana
books.author: Juan de Torquemada

books.title: Annales de Domingo Francisco de San Antón Muñón Chimalpahin Quauhtlehuanitzin: sixième et septième relations (1258-1612)
books.author: Domingo Francisco de San Antón Muñón Chimalpahin Quauhtlehuanitzin (ed. and trans. Rémi Siméon)
books.note: Nahuatl text of the 6th and 7th Relaciones with Siméon's facing French translation — the only pre-1928 printing of Chimalpahin's own words.

books.title: Grammaire de la langue nahuatl ou mexicaine, composée en 1547
books.author: Andrés de Olmos (ed. Rémi Siméon)
books.note: Olmos's 1547 Arte, the earliest surviving grammar of any American language, printed for the first time from the manuscript; Olmos's Spanish text with Siméon's French apparatus.

books.title: Grammatica, o Arte de la lengua general de los indios de los reynos del Perú
books.author: Domingo de Santo Tomás
books.note: First edition, Valladolid 1560 — the first grammar of any Andean language. John Carter Brown copy.

books.title: Lexicon, o Vocabulario de la lengua general del Perú
books.author: Domingo de Santo Tomás
books.note: First edition, Valladolid 1560, companion to the Grammatica.

books.title: History of the Incas
books.author: Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa (trans. Clements R. Markham)
books.note: Hakluyt Society. The 1572 Historia de los Incas written for Viceroy Toledo; the Spanish text (Pietschmann, Göttingen 1906) has no open scan.

books.title: Narratives of the Rites and Laws of the Yncas
books.author: Cristóbal de Molina; Juan de Santa Cruz Pachacuti Yamqui; Francisco de Ávila; Polo de Ondegardo (trans. Clements R. Markham)
books.note: Hakluyt Society. Carries Molina's Relación de las fábulas y ritos de los Incas in English; no pre-1928 Spanish printing is openly scanned.

books.title: Historia de las Indias, Tomo I
books.author: Bartolomé de las Casas
books.note: First printing of the Historia (Madrid, Ginesta, 1875-76), from the manuscript. Tomo verified from the running heads. Tomo IV already held from wave 1.

books.title: Historia de las Indias, Tomo II
books.author: Bartolomé de las Casas

books.title: Historia de las Indias, Tomo III
books.author: Bartolomé de las Casas
books.note: UNC Chapel Hill copy; the California set on IA lacks Tomo III. Same edition.

books.title: Historia de las Indias, Tomo V
books.author: Bartolomé de las Casas

books.title: Apologética historia de las Indias (Historiadores de Indias, tomo I)
books.author: Bartolomé de las Casas (ed. Manuel Serrano y Sanz)
books.note: Nueva Biblioteca de Autores Españoles 13 — the first complete printing of the Apologética, Las Casas's ethnography of the Americas written to prove the Indians' rational capacity.

books.title: Diálogo llamado Demócrates
books.author: Juan Ginés de Sepúlveda (trans. Antonio Barba)
books.note: Seville, Cromberger 1541 — Barba's Spanish of the Democrates PRIMUS (on war and Christianity), the dialogue the Democrates alter continues. Universidad de Sevilla copy.

books.title: Boletín de la Real Academia de la Historia, tomo XXI (1892) — with the Democrates alter of Sepúlveda
books.author: Real Academia de la Historia; Juan Ginés de Sepúlveda (ed. Marcelino Menéndez Pelayo)
books.note: The Democrates alter, sive de justis belli causis apud Indos — Sepúlveda's side of the Valladolid debate — was first printed here (pp. 257-369, Latin with Menéndez Pelayo's Spanish). Getty copy; the whole tomo is taken because that is the unit IA has.

books.title: História da província Santa Cruz a que vulgarmente chamamos Brasil
books.author: Pero de Magalhães de Gândavo
books.note: First edition, Lisbon 1576 — the first printed book about Brazil, with Camões's dedicatory verses. John Carter Brown copy.

books.title: Tratado descritivo do Brasil em 1587
books.author: Gabriel Soares de Sousa (ed. Francisco Adolfo de Varnhagen)
books.note: Varnhagen's second edition. The fullest 16th-century description of Brazil, its peoples and natural history.

books.title: Arte de grammatica da lingua mais usada na costa do Brasil
books.author: José de Anchieta (ed. Julius Platzmann)
books.note: Platzmann's Leipzig facsimile of the 1595 Coimbra first edition — the first Tupi grammar. Library of Congress copy (has the orig_jp2 tier); the Michigan scan of the same edition lists no jp2 files.

books.title: Cartas do Brasil (1549-1560)
books.author: Manuel da Nóbrega
books.note: Rio de Janeiro, Imprensa Nacional 1886 — the first collected Nóbrega. Scan of the Biblioteca Nacional (Brasil) copy; looked at, is a scan.

books.title: História do Brasil (1500-1627)
books.author: Vicente do Salvador (ed. Capistrano de Abreu)
books.note: Capistrano de Abreu's 1918 edition of the first history of Brazil written in Brazil (1627). Looked at, is a scan.
